messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up — Liam starts Mon 3/15 (remote, PST). Need I-9 + background check completed before Day 1. Can someone own intake and laptop/badge logistics?
PeopleOpsBot: New hire checklist: 1) Complete I-9 via Onboard link 2) Finish Checkr background consent 3) Benefits enrollment (within 30 days) 4) Laptop & badge shipping — confirm address. https://hr.redwood.example/onboard
Liam: Hi all — thanks! Remote in PST. Quick Q: how does the I-9 work if I'm not local? Can it be done entirely online?
Ana: @Liam you have two options: 1) Remote verification via our vendor (Onboard) — upload acceptable docs in the link above and do the video verify. 2) In-person verification — any Redwood employee or an authorized agent can physically inspect docs. Acceptable docs: passport OR (DL + SSN card). Please do NOT send photos over Slack.
Sam: @Liam also need your shipping address for the laptop. We'll ship the macbook and power adapter. If you prefer FedEx/UPS hold-for-pickup let me know.
Liam: Shipping to 1234 Sequoia Ave, Apt 2, Oakland, CA 94607. FedEx hold is fine — I'll pick up. Rough ETA?
Sam: Shipping today if we get address by noon. ETA 48-72 hrs. I'll post tracking once label is printed. Example: `1Z999AA10123456784`
Morgan: Day 1 plan: 9:00–12:00 onboarding + benefits overview (Zoom link in calendar invite), 1:00 team intro + 1:1. Buddy: Priya. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
Ana: FYI background check is via Checkr — you'll receive a consent email from jobs@checkr.com. Please complete within 24hrs to avoid delay. If any flags come up, we'll loop in hiring manager.
Liam: Got the Checkr email. Doing it now. Also: benefits enrollment window?
Ana: Benefits enrollment: 30-day window from start date. Quick link: https://benefits.redwood.example/enroll. If you want a walkthrough, I can book a 20-min benefits session.
Morgan: Welcome aboard, @Liam! We'll assign initial onboarding tasks in Notion and add you to team channels. One ask: please complete the I-9 and Checkr before EOD Friday so IT can finish provisioning.
Sam: Noted — will hold provisioning until I-9/Checkr complete. I'll DM once laptop ships + for temporary VPN creds.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled — If documents incomplete by Fri 5pm PT, People Ops will reach out to escalate. :calendar:
